expanded_deck: Dr. Andy holds King-Jack suited (K♥ J♥) against Kyle's Ace-Four (A♥ 4♣) with $15,000 in the middle on the Champions Social Club Dallas livestream — how would you play Andy's hand?
expanded_body:
Originally posted October 4, 2026.

Kyle puts Dr. Andy in the blender at Champions Social Club in Dallas!

In a high-pressure $15,000 pot on the Champions Social Club Dallas feature stream (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1084950954282668/), Dr. Andy found himself put to the test holding King-Jack of hearts (K♥ J♥) against Kyle's Ace-Four offsuit (A♥ 4♣) at a deep-stacked table alongside JB ($10.9K), RamseyTheRam ($7.0K), Scott L ($6.7K), and NDN ($4.3K).

Watch the hand play out and tell us: how would you play Andy's hand?

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
